# KeyPicker

Choose one or more Camelot keys from a compact 12 × 2 grid (minor A row, major B row), each key shown as its wheel-colour dot plus the code in mono, with a one…

`SongNodes.KeyPicker` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.KeyPicker label="…" value={…} onChange={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.KeyPicker" label="…" value="{{…}}" on-change="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (KeyPickerProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` | Visible label ("Keys"). |
| `value` * | `CamelotKey[]` | Selected keys. |
| `onChange` * | `(value: CamelotKey[]) => void` | Change handler. |
| `currentKey` | `"1A" \| "1B" \| "2A" \| "2B" \| "3A" \| "3B" \| "4A" \| "4B" \| "5A" \| "5B" \| "6A" \| "6B" \| "7A" \| "7B" \| "8A" \| "8B" \| "9A" \| "9B" \| "10A" \| "10B" \| "11A" \| "11B" \| "12A" \| "12B"` | Key of the playing or reference track; marked with the now bar and used by the quick select. |
| `suggested` | `CamelotKey[]` | Keys to outline as suggestions. |
| `single` | `boolean` | Allow only one key (aria-pressed on one button at a time). |
